# The Bad Software Company

> Start with a TestOpsy to find the conditions making software unreliable, then move from findings to decisions and implementation.

This file points agents to Markdown-friendly mirrors of the primary public pages and blog posts for badsoftware.com. Each mirror includes its canonical HTML source URL.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://badsoftware.com/index.html.md): Start with a TestOpsy to find the conditions making software unreliable, then move from findings to decisions and implementation.
- [About](https://badsoftware.com/about.html.md): Learn how The Bad Software Company helps organizations understand why software, AI systems, and engineering organizations fail to meet expectations.
- [TestOpsy](https://badsoftware.com/testopsy.html.md): A structured assessment of the systems, processes, architecture, tooling, and feedback loops that shape software quality.
- [Advisory](https://badsoftware.com/advisory.html.md): Evidence-based guidance for deciding what to change, what to defer, and how to measure whether the response is working.
- [Implementation](https://badsoftware.com/implementation.html.md): Hands-on engineering that turns assessed problems and prioritized recommendations into working software and maintainable systems.
- [How We Help](https://badsoftware.com/services.html.md): An overview of the path from TestOpsy assessment through Advisory and hands-on Implementation.
- [Discuss a TestOpsy](https://badsoftware.com/contact.html.md): Request a free 30-minute fit call to discuss what you are seeing and whether a TestOpsy is the right next step.
- [Insights](https://badsoftware.com/blog/index.html.md): Articles, research, talks, and company news from The Bad Software Company.

## Case Studies
- [Restoring Mailinator's Developer Experience](https://badsoftware.com/case-studies/mailinator-developer-experience.html.md): Creating an API source of truth, modernizing four SDKs, and measuring adoption of the resulting releases.
